needs.proposedSignature: StaticEffect: { kind: 'cant-be-countered'; scope?: 'self' | 'you-control' | 'all'; filter?: Filter; who?: 'you' | 'any' }
needs.semantics: 'Spells can't be countered.' (every spell) and 'Noncreature spells you control can't be countered.' The existing `cant-be-countered` static carries no fields and the engine reads it only off the countered spell's own source (game.ts:1108 and 1316), so a permanent cannot protect other spells at all. Adding scope/filter/who and checking every battlefield source in the counter path covers both cards.

needs.proposedSignature: Effect: { op: 'grant-alt-cost'; target: TargetSpec | Ref | { filter: Filter; zone: SetZone; who: ScopeWho }; altCost: AltCost | 'flashback-equal-to-mana-cost' | 'mayhem-equal-to-mana-cost'; duration: 'eot' | 'permanent' }  and StaticEffect: { kind: 'grant-alt-cost'; zone: SetZone; filter?: Filter; altCost: ... }
needs.semantics: Hands an alternative cost to OTHER cards, in a zone, either for a duration (Snapcaster Mage, Past in Flames) or as a static (Lier, Green Goblin). 'The flashback cost is equal to its mana cost' needs the cost to be derived per card rather than printed. Today `gain-ability` writes only on the source (game.ts:1327) and cost-alter's `cast-from` is an unconditional, non-exiling static with no duration, so every card of this shape either fails or would be scripted far stronger than it is.
needs.clause: Each instant and sorcery card in your graveyard gains flashback until end of turn. The flashback cost is equal to its mana cost.
